ns2:course.label: Global History
ns2:course.description: Broad introduction to global history, by exploring the global structures and transnational forces that have shaped human history, from the emergence of agriculture and urban centers to our contemporary global village. This course can be used to fulfill either Western or Nonwestern general education categories but not both.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Hist&Philosoph Perspect, Non-Western Cultures, and Western Compartv Cult course.
